main_text.p: tur, quibus luem ueneream omnia morbo- rum genera, intemperiem, prauam confor- mationem & diffolutionem cotinui in fefe completi, apertisime demonstrat. Caete- rum huius maligni affectus caufas exterio- res recenfere non conuenit, quadoquidem manifeftae faris funt, nec agricolas ipfos la- tent. Et quemadmodu eius uariae funt diffe rentiae, ac fpecies, ita uarijs medicamentis profligatur. Veruntamen ueteres, & quae tophos iam pepererut, atq; abfceffus in of- fibus rectius gaiaco, quam fchina, & falza parilla curantur. Exulceratae uero & ex- tuberantes mercurio feliciter & tuto fa- nantur, dum modo exulceratu non fit oris palatum: huc enim hoc remedio abftinen- dum eft. Totum namq; uirus illuc propel- lere folet. Neutrae tamen abfq; triplici au- xiliorum genere probe curantur, quorum primum eft, quod primam corporis regio- nem, hoc eft, quae epigaftrio infunt & con- tinetur, euacuat. Tale autem eft electarium catholicum, cafsiae fiftularis medulla: alte- rum quod fecundam & ea, quae in uenis & arterijs confiftunt, purgat: quod fane diu- reticis commode fieri folet. page.notes: Printed text is in the book's old spelling. The page number "220" is read from a worn running head "220 IN ABDITAS RER. NATVR."; the first digit is partly faded. Several lines are doubtful: "uirus illuc" and "fit oris" (the printed word may be "fit oris" or "sit oris"); "tuto" in "feliciter & tuto" is partly faded; "huc enim" may be "huc enim" with a fainter mark; "fchina" and "falza" are clear. The word "infidet" at the foot is printed with the t partly obscured. The first line of the page is a continuation from the previous page and is marked cont="true". The fragment "tur," at the start is a fragment and is left as printed. No marginal notes, catchword or signature are visible.
